title: ExternalMessage
description: Normalized communication message without provider-specific API structures.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier, unique across message sources. Adapters should namespace provider identifiers.

sender.description: Human-readable sender label, not a provider user object.

content.description: Normalized plain text. May be empty for a message without text.

timestamp.description: Time the message was sent, not the time it was fetched.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.
